Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The instrument shall provide an adjustable section thickness range of 1–100 μm or better. 2. Section thickness shall be adjustable in 1 μm increments within the fine sectioning range or better. 3. The cryostat shall accommodate specimens of at least 55 × 55 mm or larger. 4. The specimen feed mechanism shall provide a minimum horizontal feed of 25 mm. 5. The instrument shall have a minimum vertical specimen stroke of 59 mm. 6. The system shall be equipped with automatic specimen retraction to minimize section compression and improve section quality. 7. The specimen head shall provide X–Y orientation adjustment for precise specimen alignment. 8. The cryostat shall include a minimum of eight (8) quick-freeze stations forrapid specimen freezing. 9. The system should support an optional rapid freezing device/Peltier freezing station capable of achievin g temperatures up to −42°C or lower. 10. The cryochamber shall maintain an operating temperature of −35°C or lower. 11. The instrument should be equipped with an integrated UV disinfection system and AgProtect nano- silver coating or an equivalent chamber decontamination feature. 12. The cryochamber should incorporate an antimicrobial-coated interior surface or equivalent technology to reduce microbial contamination. 13. The instrument shall have a digital LED/LCD display with dedicated function keys or touchscreen interf ace for monitoring and controlling operating parameters. 14. The handwheel shall incorporate a mechanical locking mechanism to ensure operator safety during sp ecimen handling. 15. The blade holder shall include essential safety features such as a finger guard, blade ejector, and palm rest. 16. The instrument shall include a robust anti-roll section transfer/stretching device with an adjustable anti -roll glass plate (or equivalent technology) to facilitate the production of flat, wrinkle-free frozen sections b y preventing section rolling during cutting through a precisely controlled gap between the blade and anti-r oll guide. 17. The instrument shall provide automatic and manual defrost functions. 18. The system should retain commonly used operating parameters, including chamber temperature, real- time clock; defrost schedule, section thickness, specimen retraction settings, and other operational setting s to ensure uninterrupted workflow after power cycling. 19. The bidder shall arrange a live demonstration of the offered model to establish compliance with all the quoted technical specifications and functional requirements. Only those features successfully demonstrate d and verified by the technical evaluation committee shall be considered compliant. Failure to demonstrat e any quoted specification may result in rejection of the technical bid. 20. 5 years’ warranty along with machine. 21. 10 bottles of OCT medium should be provided free of cost.

The bidder has to give a confirmation that the spares for quoted item will be available for atleast ten Ye ars. . 6. In case OEM is taking onus of this compliance, OEM undertaking is to be uploaded along with Bidder undertaking) 8. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 9. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 10. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of The Director, CDRI, Lucknow A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 11. DD should be made in favour of The Director CDRI payable at Lucknow .
